# The TeX Live packages the article is built with. The `tests` workflow
# installs them from CTAN and caches the installation on a hash of this file,
# so a change here is a new installation.
#
# Beyond the basic scheme, these hold the files a build of the article reads,
# as `latexmk -recorder` lists them in aia-94-leak.fls, and those that
# matplotlib's usetex reads. When the article starts to use another package,
# add the TeX Live package that holds it (`tlmgr search --global --file`).
scheme-basic
latexmk

# the article
acronym
bigfoot # suffix.sty
epsf
fontname
helvetic
lastpage
lineno
siunitx
textcase
translations
ulem
xcolor
xstring

# the Type 1 versions of the EC fonts, for the article and for matplotlib
cm-super

# matplotlib's usetex preamble, and the program that renders its text in
# raster images
type1cm
underscore
dvipng
